qualified candidates can lose opportunities when their resumes contain formatting elements that confuse ATS systems. Understanding these common pitfalls helps you avoid unnecessary rejection before a human ever sees your application.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Graphics, Images, and Visual Elements","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"While creative designs may look impressive to the human eye, ATS systems cannot read graphics, photos, logos, or charts. These visual elements often cause parsing errors, resulting in missing or garbled information. Stick to text-based content exclusively to ensure your qualifications are properly captured.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Tables and Complex Formatting Structures","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Tables pose significant challenges for ATS parsing. When you organize information in table cells, the system may read content in the wrong order or skip sections entirely. This applies to multi-column layouts as well, which can scramble your carefully crafted content into an unreadable mess.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Instead of tables, use simple bullet points and standard paragraph formatting. This approach ensures your information flows logically when the ATS extracts and processes it.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Headers, Footers, and Text Boxes","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Many ATS platforms ignore content placed in headers and footers completely. If you've included your contact information, page numbers, or other critical details in these areas, they may never reach the hiring manager. Always place essential information in the main body of your document.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Text boxes create similar problems. Content within text boxes often gets skipped during parsing, leaving gaps in your professional narrative.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Unconventional Section Headings","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Using creative or non-standard section titles can prevent ATS systems from properly categorizing your information. Labels like \"My Journey\" or \"What I Bring to the Table\" may confuse the software, which looks for conventional headings like \"Work Experience\" and \"Education.\"","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Stick to traditional, recognizable section names that align with what ATS systems expect to find.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Inconsistent Date Formatting","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Inconsistent date formats throughout your resume can trigger parsing errors. Switching between formats like \"January 2020,\" \"01/2020,\" and \"Jan '20\" creates confusion. Choose one clear format and apply it consistently across all entries.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Poor Keyword Optimization","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Failing to incorporate relevant keywords naturally throughout your resume means the ATS may not identify you as a match for the position. Review the job description carefully and ensure your resume reflects the terminology and skills the employer is seeking, without resorting to keyword stuffing.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Special Characters and Symbols","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Decorative symbols, unusual bullet styles, and special characters can cause ATS systems to misread your content. Use standard round bullets and avoid ornamental elements that serve no functional purpose.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Improper File Format","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Submitting your resume in an incompatible file format is one of the easiest mistakes to avoid. Unless the job posting specifically requests otherwise, use .docx or PDF formats. Avoid uncommon file types that ATS systems may not support.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"By Your Resume for Each Job Application","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"One of the most effective strategies for improving your resume formatting and ATS success is customization. Sending the same generic resume to every employer significantly reduces your chances of passing ATS screening and catching a hiring manager's attention.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Every job posting contains unique requirements, preferred qualifications, and specific language that reflects what the employer values most. When you tailor your resume to mirror these elements, you demonstrate that you've taken time to understand the role and can clearly articulate how your experience aligns with their needs.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Why Customization Matters for ATS","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Applicant tracking systems scan your resume for keywords and phrases that match the job description. A resume optimized for one position may lack the specific terminology needed for another role, even within the same field. By customizing your resume for each application, you increase the keyword match rate that ATS algorithms use to rank candidates.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Tailoring also helps you prioritize relevant experience. The accomplishments and skills most important for one position may differ from those needed for another, even if both fall under your expertise area.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"How to Align Your Resume with Job Requirements","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Start by carefully reading the job posting and identifying key requirements, qualifications, and responsibilities. Look for repeated terms, required skills, and specific credentials mentioned multiple times—these signal priority to the employer.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Next, review your current resume and identify where your experience matches these requirements. Adjust your professional summary, skills section, and work experience descriptions to emphasize relevant achievements using similar language to the job posting.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"For example, if a job description emphasizes \"cross-functional team leadership\" rather than \"project management,\" use their preferred terminology when describing your relevant experience. This strategic alignment improves both ATS matching and human readability.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Efficient Methods for Resume Tailoring","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Create a master resume document that contains all your experience, skills, and accomplishments in detail. This comprehensive version serves as your source material for customized versions.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"For each application, save a copy and modify it to highlight the most relevant 70-80% of content while removing or condensing less applicable information. A simple spreadsheet noting the company, position, date applied, and file name helps you stay organized and reference the correct version for follow-up communications.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Balancing Efficiency with Effectiveness","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"While thorough customization yields the best results, you can work more efficiently by creating 2-3 base templates for different types of roles you're pursuing. Move critical keywords into the main body text where systems can reliably detect them.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Compare your resume against job descriptions for roles you're targeting. The most effective resumes strike a balance between machine readability and compelling storytelling that resonates with hiring managers. Your goal is to pass the digital gatekeeper while creating a document that makes recruiters excited to call you.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Start by thinking of ATS optimization as your foundation, not your ceiling. Use clean formatting, standard fonts, and clear section headings to ensure your resume parses correctly. Then layer in strategic content that showcases your unique value proposition. Strong action verbs, quantifiable achievements, and context-rich descriptions transform a technically sound resume into a persuasive career narrative.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Writing for Both Audiences Simultaneously","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The key is integrating keywords naturally within achievement-focused bullet points. Instead of listing duties, frame your experience around results. A well-crafted resume serves both purposes effectively. Focus on clarity, relevance, and results. Bold text for company names and job titles adds emphasis while remaining machine-readable. Simple horizontal lines can separate sections without causing technical issues.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Consider how your resume appears at first glance. Recruiters typically spend just seconds on initial screening, so your most impressive achievements should be immediately visible. Place your strongest qualifications near the top of each section, and use concise formatting that allows quick scanning while maintaining comprehensive detail.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The Power of Strategic Storytelling","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"While ATS systems scan for keywords and credentials, human recruiters look for patterns of growth, problem-solving ability, and cultural fit. Weave these elements into your experience descriptions without sacrificing technical optimization. Show progression in your career through increasingly responsible roles or expanding skill sets.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Your resume should answer the recruiter's unspoken questions: Can this person do the job? Will they add value to our team? Do their achievements suggest they'll succeed in this role? Address these concerns through specific examples that demonstrate both competence and initiative, all while maintaining the clean structure that ATS systems require.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Maintaining Authenticity","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Never sacrifice accuracy or authenticity for optimization. Keyword stuffing or exaggerating qualifications may pass initial ATS screening but will fail during human review or interviews. Focus on genuine strengths and legitimate accomplishments. The most effective resumes honestly represent your professional identity while presenting it in the most favorable, relevant light.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Remember that passing ATS is just the first step. By creating a document that satisfies technical requirements while engaging human readers, you maximize your chances at every stage of the hiring process.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Sources","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"ul","type":"list","start":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"listitem","value":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://burnettspecialists.com/blog/how-to-optimize-your-resume-for-ats-systems/","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"How To Optimize Your Resume For ATS Systems","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"listitem","value":2,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://scale.jobs/blog/beat-ats-rejections-now-human-proof-your-application","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Beat ATS Rejections Now: Human-Proof Your Application","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"}],"listType":"bullet","direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"h2","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Conclusion","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Mastering resume formatting for ATS compatibility is no longer optional in today's competitive job market—it's essential. Remember that bullet points are acceptable, but fancy symbols, shading, and font colors beyond standard black should be avoided.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Early in my career, I witnessed firsthand how these principles transformed outcomes for job seekers. Within weeks, she received multiple interview invitations. That experience reinforced my belief that an ATS-optimized resume isn't about gaming the system—it's about ensuring your professional potential shines through in a format that meets both digital and human expectations.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"As you implement these strategies, prioritize clear structure, job-specific keywords, and standard file formats. Understanding these changes is essential for anyone looking to remain competitive in today's evolving workplace.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The Rise of Skills-Based Hiring","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"One of the most significant shifts in employer demands is the move away from credential-based hiring toward skills-based evaluation. Employers across industries now expect candidates to work alongside AI systems, whether that means using AI-powered analytics tools, collaborating with automated systems, or understanding how to leverage machine learning insights.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The integration of AI into daily workflows means that employer demands now include a baseline comfort with technology that adapts and learns. This reality has made strategic resume writing more important than ever in meeting employer demands.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"What This Means for Job Seekers","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The 2026 employer landscape rewards professionals who can adapt quickly, demonstrate practical skills, and navigate technology-enabled workplaces. As workplaces become more diverse and hybrid communication models become standard, the ability to understand and manage emotions—both your own and others'—directly impacts team performance and organizational culture.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Understanding the emotions of others is essential for effective engagement with coworkers, managers, and direct reports. This skill enables professionals to navigate complex interpersonal dynamics, resolve conflicts constructively, and build the psychological safety that high-performing teams require.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Why Emotional Intelligence Matters in 2026","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The modern workplace demands professionals who can manage diverse teams across different locations, time zones, and cultural backgrounds. Hybrid and remote work environments amplify the need for strong interpersonal skills because traditional face-to-face cues are often absent.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Conflict resolution has become more nuanced in distributed teams. Professionals who can identify tension early, facilitate difficult conversations, and find collaborative solutions help organizations maintain productivity and morale. Building psychological safety—where team members feel comfortable sharing ideas and admitting mistakes—requires consistent demonstration of empathy and active listening.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Demonstrating Emotional Intelligence on Your Resume","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Soft skills focusing on interpersonal abilities and emotional intelligence are transferable across industries and equally important as technical competencies. When showcasing these skills on your resume, move beyond simply listing \"emotional intelligence\" in a skills section.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Instead, performance and retention\"","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"listitem","value":4,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Change management","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":1,"version":1},{"mode":"normal","text":": \"Led organizational transition by addressing team concerns and maintaining morale during restructuring\"","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"listType":"bullet","direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Practical Application Strategies","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"When describing your experience, focus on outcomes that demonstrate emotional intelligence in action. Highlight situations where you recognized team dynamics, adapted your communication style, or created inclusive environments.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use action verbs that convey interpersonal competence: facilitated, mentored, collaborated, mediated, coached, or influenced. Pair these with specific contexts that show your ability to navigate complex human dynamics in professional settings.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"For hybrid work environments, emphasize your ability to build relationships remotely, maintain team cohesion across digital platforms, and communicate effectively through various channels. These capabilities signal to employers that you can thrive in the flexible work models that define 2026 workplaces.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Sources","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"ul","type":"list","start":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"listitem","value":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/insights/landing-job/skills-that-will-make-your-resume-pop","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Skills to Put on a Resume Employers Will Actually Read","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"listitem","value":2,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://www.resume.org/career-center/best-skills-for-resume/","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Best Skills for Resume (Plus Examples)","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"}],"listType":"bullet","direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"h2","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Adaptability and Continuous Learning","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Rapid industry changes have made adaptability one of the most sought-after qualities in today's workforce. Employers are no longer looking for professionals who simply excel at current tasks; they need people who can pivot quickly when markets shift, technologies evolve, or business models transform. The ability to embrace change and learn new skills on demand has become a defining characteristic of successful careers.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The pace of change means that what you learned in school or even last year may already be outdated. Professionals who demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning signal to employers that they won't become obsolete. This mindset is especially critical as automation handles routine tasks, leaving humans to tackle complex, evolving challenges that require fresh thinking and updated knowledge.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Microlearning and Skill Stacking","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Microlearning has emerged as a practical approach to staying current without overwhelming your schedule. Instead of committing to lengthy degree programs, professionals are taking short online courses, attending webinars, and earning micro-credentials in targeted areas. This approach allows you to build skills incrementally and apply them immediately in your work.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Skill stacking—combining multiple complementary skills—creates unique value propositions. For example, a marketing professional who adds data analytics and basic coding skills becomes far more versatile than someone with marketing expertise alone. This combination of abilities makes you adaptable across different projects and roles.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Cross-Functional Experience","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Cross-functional experience demonstrates adaptability in action. When you've worked across departments or taken on projects outside your core role, you show employers that you can understand different perspectives and contribute beyond narrow job descriptions. This breadth of experience is increasingly valuable as organizations flatten hierarchies and expect employees to collaborate across traditional boundaries.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Volunteering for projects in adjacent departments, participating in company-wide initiatives, or taking temporary assignments in different areas all build this cross-functional capability. These experiences also expose you to diverse working styles and problem-solving approaches, further enhancing your adaptability.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Demonstrating Growth Mindset on Your Resume","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Your resume should clearly communicate your commitment to continuous learning and adaptability. Rather than simply listing skills, show how you've acquired and applied new capabilities. Include specific examples of times you learned something new to solve a problem or adapted to significant changes.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Consider phrases like \"quickly mastered new project management software to streamline team workflows\" or \"adapted communication strategies for remote team environment, maintaining productivity during transition.\" These statements show both the learning process and the practical outcome.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Highlight any certifications, courses, or training programs you've completed, especially recent ones. This demonstrates ongoing investment in your professional development. If you've pivoted roles or industries successfully, frame those transitions as evidence of your adaptability rather than career uncertainty.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Building Resilience Through Change","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Adaptability isn't just about learning new skills; it's also about maintaining effectiveness during uncertainty. Employers value professionals who remain productive and positive when facing organizational changes, market disruptions, or unexpected challenges. This resilience comes from experience navigating change successfully.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"When describing past roles, include examples of how you've handled transitions, whether that's implementing new systems, adjusting to leadership changes, or responding to market shifts. These concrete examples prove your ability to thrive in dynamic environments rather than simply claiming you're adaptable.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h2","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"As automation increasingly handles routine tasks, employers are placing a premium on professionals who can think critically, solve complex problems creatively, and approach challenges with strategic insight. These cognitive skills represent the human advantage in an AI-augmented workplace—the ability to analyze ambiguous situations, synthesize information from multiple sources, and develop innovative solutions that machines cannot replicate.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Critical thinking involves evaluating information objectively, questioning assumptions, and making reasoned judgments. In practice, this means distinguishing between correlation and causation, identifying biases in data, and recognizing when conventional approaches may no longer apply. Employers value candidates who can move beyond surface-level analysis to uncover root causes and systemic issues.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Problem-solving extends beyond identifying issues to developing actionable solutions. The most effective problem-solvers combine analytical rigor with creative thinking, exploring multiple pathways before selecting the optimal approach. They consider constraints, anticipate unintended consequences, and adapt their strategies based on feedback and changing conditions.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Demonstrating These Skills Through Achievements","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"When showcasing critical thinking and problem-solving abilities on your resume, focus on quantifiable achievements that illustrate your analytical process and impact. Rather than simply listing these skills, demonstrate them through concrete examples that follow a clear framework.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Structure your accomplishments using the challenge-action-result approach. Begin by briefly describing the problem or opportunity you identified, then explain the analytical methods or creative approaches you employed, and conclude with measurable outcomes. For instance, instead of stating \"strong problem-solving skills,\" describe how you analyzed workflow inefficiencies, implemented a new process, and reduced completion time by a specific percentage.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Include metrics that demonstrate the scope and impact of your work. Numbers provide context and credibility—whether it's cost savings, time reductions, revenue increases, or improvements in quality metrics. These quantifiable results help hiring managers understand the value you brought to previous roles and envision the contributions you could make to their organization.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Frameworks for Strategic Thinking","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Strategic thinking involves connecting day-to-day decisions to broader organizational goals. Employers seek professionals who can see the bigger picture, anticipate future trends, and align their work with long-term objectives. This skill becomes particularly valuable as organizations navigate rapid market changes and technological disruption.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Demonstrate strategic thinking by highlighting instances where you identified opportunities before they became obvious, proposed initiatives that aligned with company vision, or contributed to planning processes. Show how you balanced short-term needs with long-term sustainability, or how your analysis influenced key decisions.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Cross-functional problem-solving also signals strategic capability. When you can synthesize perspectives from different departments, understand how various functions interconnect, and develop solutions that benefit the organization holistically, you demonstrate the systems-thinking approach that employers increasingly demand.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Analytical Skills in Practice","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Employers value candidates who can work with data to inform decisions, even in non-technical roles. This doesn't necessarily mean advanced statistical analysis—it means being comfortable interpreting information, identifying patterns, and drawing evidence-based conclusions. Whether you're analyzing customer feedback, evaluating project performance, or assessing market trends, the ability to translate data into actionable insights sets you apart.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Highlight your analytical approach by describing the methodologies you used, the tools you leveraged, and how your analysis led to specific recommendations or actions. This demonstrates both technical competence and the judgment to apply analysis appropriately.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Creative problem-solving complements analytical skills by enabling you to generate novel solutions when conventional approaches fall short. Showcase instances where you developed innovative workarounds, adapted strategies from other contexts, or combined existing resources in new ways to overcome obstacles. These examples illustrate your ability to think beyond established patterns and bring fresh perspectives to challenges.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Sources","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"ul","type":"list","start":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"listitem","value":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://www.careerkit.me/blog/75-skills-to-put-on-resume-in-2026-what-recruiters-actually-look-for","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"75+ Skills to Put on Resume in 2026: What Recruiters Actually Look For","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"listitem","value":2,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://www.mployee.me/blog/most-important-skills-for-resume","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Most Important Skills For Resume","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"}],"listType":"bullet","direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"h2","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Collaboration and Remote Teamwork","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The shift to remote and hybrid work models has fundamentally changed how teams operate. By 2026, employers demand professionals who can collaborate effectively across time zones, cultures, and digital platforms. Remote teamwork is no longer a temporary adaptation—it's a core competency that defines workplace success.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Asynchronous collaboration has become essential as distributed teams work across different schedules. This means communicating clearly in writing, documenting decisions thoroughly, and respecting colleagues' time boundaries. Professionals who excel at asynchronous work understand how to keep projects moving forward without requiring everyone to be online simultaneously.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Cross-Cultural Communication Skills","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Global teams bring diverse perspectives, but they also require cultural sensitivity and adaptability. Effective cross-cultural communicators recognize different communication styles, adjust their approach for international colleagues, and build inclusive team environments. This skill extends beyond language proficiency to understanding cultural norms around feedback, hierarchy, and decision-making.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Virtual leadership has emerged as a distinct capability. Leading remote teams requires intentional relationship-building, clear goal-setting, and the ability to maintain team morale without face-to-face interaction. Virtual leaders create structure while remaining flexible, ensuring accountability without micromanaging.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Digital Collaboration Tool Proficiency","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Mastery of collaboration platforms is no longer optional. Employers expect fluency with video conferencing tools, project management software, shared document systems, and team communication platforms. Professionals who can quickly adopt new tools and optimize workflows for remote environments stand out in the job market.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"When demonstrating remote work success on your resume, focus on specific achievements rather than simply listing tools. Describe how you coordinated cross-functional projects, managed virtual teams, or improved remote processes. Include relevant keywords like 'collaborated,' 'team coordination,' 'virtual project management,' and 'asynchronous communication' within the context of your experiences to optimize for applicant tracking systems.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Quantify your remote collaboration impact whenever possible. Did you lead a distributed team that delivered a project ahead of schedule? Did you implement a new collaboration system that improved team productivity? These concrete examples show employers you possess the remote teamwork skills they demand.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Sources","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"ul","type":"list","start":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"listitem","value":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://resumeworded.com/teamwork-on-resume-key-advice","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"How To Demonstrate Teamwork Skills on Your Resume","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"}],"direction":"ltr"}],"listType":"bullet","direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"h2","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Top Job Market Skills by Industry","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Understanding which skills matter most in your target industry helps you tailor your professional development and resume strategy effectively. While foundational competencies like digital literacy and emotional intelligence span all sectors, each industry places unique emphasis on specific skill combinations that align with its operational demands and future direction.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Technology Sector","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The technology industry continues to prioritize technical proficiency alongside human-centered skills. Software development, cloud computing expertise, and cybersecurity knowledge remain essential technical foundations. However, employers increasingly value candidates who can bridge technical and business contexts—translating complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders and collaborating across diverse teams.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Adaptability stands out as particularly critical in tech, where tools and frameworks evolve rapidly. Professionals who demonstrate continuous learning through certifications, personal projects, or contributions to open-source communities signal their readiness to grow with emerging technologies. Problem-solving abilities that combine analytical thinking with creative innovation help candidates stand out in competitive hiring environments.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Healthcare Industry","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Healthcare employers seek a blend of clinical competence and interpersonal excellence. Beyond specialized medical knowledge, emotional intelligence proves essential for patient care, team coordination, and high-stress decision-making. The ability to communicate clearly with patients, families, and interdisciplinary teams directly impacts care quality and outcomes.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Digital health literacy has become non-negotiable as electronic health records, telemedicine platforms, and data analytics tools reshape healthcare delivery. Professionals who can navigate these systems efficiently while maintaining the human touch in patient interactions position themselves as valuable assets. Adaptability also matters significantly, as healthcare protocols and technologies continue evolving in response to public health challenges and regulatory changes.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Financial Services","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The finance sector balances traditional analytical rigor with emerging technological demands. Data analysis, risk assessment, and regulatory compliance knowledge form the technical core. However, the rise of fintech and digital banking has elevated the importance of technological fluency—particularly with automation tools, blockchain concepts, and data visualization platforms.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities help financial professionals navigate complex scenarios and provide strategic recommendations. As remote client interactions become more common, strong communication skills and the ability to build trust through digital channels have grown increasingly important. Ethical judgment and integrity remain foundational, especially as financial decisions carry significant implications for clients and organizations.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Creative Industries","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Creative sectors value a distinctive combination of artistic vision and technical execution. Design thinking, storytelling ability, and brand strategy expertise remain central to roles in marketing, advertising, and content creation. However, digital tool proficiency has become equally essential—from graphic design software and video editing platforms to content management systems and analytics tools.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Collaboration skills prove particularly important in creative work, where projects typically involve cross-functional teams including designers, writers, developers, and strategists. The ability to accept constructive feedback, iterate on concepts, and balance creative vision with business objectives distinguishes successful professionals. Adaptability helps creative workers stay relevant as consumer preferences, platform algorithms, and media formats continuously shift.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Service Sectors","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Service industries—including hospitality, retail, and customer support—place premium value on interpersonal skills and customer-centric thinking. Emotional intelligence enables service professionals to read situations quickly, respond to diverse customer needs, and handle challenging interactions with grace. Clear communication and active listening create positive experiences that build customer loyalty.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Digital literacy has transformed service roles as point-of-sale systems, customer relationship management platforms, and scheduling tools become standard. Problem-solving abilities help service workers address customer concerns efficiently and identify opportunities to improve processes. Adaptability proves essential in service environments where priorities shift rapidly and workers must adjust to changing customer expectations, staffing levels, and operational procedures.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Identifying Your Priority Skills","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"To determine which skills matter most for your career goals, research job postings in your target industry and role level. Notice which competencies appear repeatedly in position descriptions and which are listed as requirements versus preferences. This analysis helps you prioritize your skill development efforts and tailor your resume to emphasize the most relevant capabilities.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Consider also where industries are heading rather than just where they are today. Emerging trends like artificial intelligence integration, sustainability initiatives, and global collaboration are reshaping employer demands across sectors. Developing skills that position you for future industry directions—not just current needs—creates lasting career advantage.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h2","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Showcasing These Skills on Your Resume","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Your resume is your first opportunity to demonstrate that you meet employer demands. Simply listing skills in a dedicated section isn't enough—you need to prove you've applied them effectively. The difference between a resume that gets noticed and one that gets overlooked often comes down to how well you integrate and demonstrate your capabilities.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use the CAR Method to Demonstrate Impact","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"The CAR method—Context, Action, Result—transforms generic skill claims into compelling evidence.     const r = await fetch(`https://publish.xencolabs.com/api/articles/${id}?depth=2`);

    const rootChildren = Array.isArray(content?.root?.children) ? content.root.children : [];

    const relatedIdx=[];

      const txt = first?.type==='text' ? String(first.text||'') : '';
      if (txt.startsWith('Related reading:')) relatedIdx.push(i);

    const matchedEdgeLinks = targetEdges.filter(t=>links.some(l=>l.url===`/${t.targetSlug}`));
    const badContainers = links.filter(l=>['heading','link'].includes(l.parentType));

const arts=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/site1_articles.json','utf8')).docs;
const phrases=['resume analysis','resume formatting','career','job search platforms','job offer assessment','ATS','employer demands'];
function extractText(node,out){
  if(!node||typeof node!=='object') return;
  if(Array.isArray(node)) return node.forEach(n=>extractText(n,out));
  if(node.type==='text' && typeof node.text==='string') out.push(node.text);
  if(node.children) extractText(node.children,out);
}
for(const a of arts){
  const out=[];extractText(a.content?.root,out);
  const text=out.join(' ').toLowerCase();
  const hits=phrases.filter(p=>text.includes(p.toLowerCase()));
  console.log(a.id, a.slug, '=>', hits.join(', '));
}
EOF

your resume past an ATS starts with proper formatting. The way you structure and present your information can mean the difference between landing an interview and getting filtered out before a human ever sees your qualifications.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Choose the Right File Format","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Always submit your resume as a .docx or .pdf file unless the job posting specifies otherwise. Most modern ATS platforms can parse both formats effectively, but .docx files tend to offer the most reliable compatibility across different systems. Avoid using .pages, .odt, or image-based formats, as these can cause parsing errors that scramble your carefully crafted content.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Select ATS-Friendly Fonts","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Stick with standard, professional fonts that ATS systems recognize easily. Arial, Calibri, Georgia, and Times New Roman are safe choices that maintain readability across both digital systems and human reviewers. Use a font size between 10 and 12 points for body text, with slightly larger sizes for your name and section headings. Decorative or script fonts may look appealing, but they often confuse parsing algorithms.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Structure With Clear Section Headings","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use conventional section headings that ATS systems expect to find. Label your sections with standard terms like \"Work Experience,\" \"Education,\" \"Skills,\" and \"Professional Summary.\" Avoid creative alternatives like \"My Journey\" or \"What I Bring to the Table,\" as these can prevent the system from categorizing your information correctly. Clear headings help the ATS map your qualifications to the right fields in its database.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Maintain Proper Margins and Spacing","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Set your margins to at least 0.5 inches on all sides, with 0.75 to 1 inch being ideal. Adequate white space helps both ATS parsing and human readability. Use consistent spacing between sections and avoid cramming too much information onto the page. A clean, well-spaced layout ensures that text doesn't run together during the parsing process.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use a Simple, Single-Column Layout","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Multi-column layouts may look sophisticated, but they often cause ATS systems to read information out of order or miss content entirely. Stick with a straightforward, single-column format that presents information in a clear, top-to-bottom flow. This structure ensures that your experience, education, and skills are parsed in the correct sequence.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Avoid Graphics, Tables, and Text Boxes","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"While visual elements can enhance a resume's appearance, they create significant problems for ATS parsing. Keep all critical content in the main body of your document using standard text formatting.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Format Dates Consistently","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use a consistent date format throughout your resume, such as \"January 2020 – March 2023\" or \"01/2020 – 03/2023.\" Avoid abbreviations that might confuse parsing algorithms, and always include both start and end dates for each position. If you're currently employed, use \"Present\" rather than leaving the end date blank.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use Standard Bullet Points","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Format your achievements and responsibilities using simple round or square bullet points. Avoid using special characters, symbols, or custom bullet designs that ATS systems may not recognize. Standard bullets help organize your information in a scannable format that both systems and hiring managers appreciate.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Save and Name Your File Properly","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Before submitting, save your resume with a professional file name that includes your name, such as \"Emily_Johnson_Resume.docx.\" Avoid generic names like \"Resume.pdf\" or \"MyResume.docx,\" which can get lost among hundreds of other applications. A clear file name helps recruiters locate your document quickly if they need to reference it later.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Sources","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"ul","type":"list","start":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"listitem","value":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://cvcraft.roynex.com/blog/ats-resume-format-2026","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"ATS Keyword Optimization Without Stuffing","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Keyword optimization is one of the most critical elements of resume formatting for ATS success. The challenge lies in incorporating relevant terms naturally while avoiding the robotic feel of keyword stuffing that both ATS algorithms and human recruiters can detect.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Identifying the Right Keywords","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Start by carefully analyzing the job description for the position you're targeting. Look for recurring terms, required skills, and specific qualifications mentioned multiple times. These repetitions signal priority to employers and should guide your keyword selection.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Pay attention to three types of keywords: hard skills (technical abilities and certifications), soft skills (communication, leadership, teamwork), and industry-specific terminology. Each category plays a role in how ATS systems score your resume against job requirements.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Natural Integration Strategies","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Once you've identified relevant keywords, integrate them throughout your resume in context. Rather than creating a separate \"keywords\" section, weave terms into your professional summary, work experience descriptions, and skills section where they genuinely reflect your qualifications.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use keywords in their various forms when appropriate. If a job description mentions \"project management,\" you might naturally include \"managed projects,\" \"project manager,\" and \"project management\" in different sections. This variation demonstrates authentic experience while improving your match score.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Avoiding Keyword Stuffing Pitfalls","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Keyword stuffing—the practice of cramming terms into your resume without context—damages both your ATS score and human readability. Modern ATS systems can detect unnatural keyword density and may flag resumes that appear manipulative.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Instead, focus on achievement-based statements that naturally incorporate keywords. For example, rather than listing \"customer service\" five times, write: \"Enhanced customer service protocols, resulting in improved client satisfaction.\" This approach demonstrates real experience while including the target keyword.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Matching Job Description Language","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Use the exact phrasing from job descriptions when it accurately reflects your experience. If an employer seeks \"data analysis\" rather than \"data analytics,\" mirror their terminology. ATS systems often search for precise matches, and this attention to detail can significantly impact your ranking.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"However, maintain authenticity. Never claim skills or experience you don't possess simply to match keywords. The goal is to present your genuine qualifications in language that resonates with both ATS algorithms and hiring managers.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Balancing Keywords Across Sections","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Distribute keywords strategically across all resume sections. Your professional summary should contain high-priority terms, while your work experience section provides opportunities to demonstrate those skills in action. The skills section offers a final keyword boost for terms that may not fit naturally elsewhere.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"type":"paragraph","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Remember that resume formatting extends beyond layout to include the strategic placement of relevant terminology. A well-optimized resume uses keywords purposefully, creating a narrative that satisfies ATS requirements while compelling human readers to learn more about your qualifications.","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr","textFormat":0},{"tag":"h3","type":"heading","format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Sources","type":"text","style":"","detail":0,"format":0,"version":1}],"direction":"ltr"},{"tag":"ul","type":"list","start":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"listitem","value":1,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1,"children":[{"type":"link","fields":{"url":"https://www.finaldraftresumes.com/post/cracking-the-ats-code-why-it-matters-now-more-than-ever","newTab":false,"linkType":"custom"},"format":"","indent":0,"version":3,"children":[{"mode":"normal","text":"Cracking
